en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a mountain village nestled in a wide alpine valley beneath dramatic, jagged peaks. Snow patches remain on the steep rock faces, while dense forests and open meadows surround a clustered group of multi‑story hotels and buildings in the foreground. Printed captions identify the scene and key peaks: the settlement of S. Martino di Castrozza at 1444 meters above sea level, with Cima Val di Roda (2800 m) and Sass Maor (2816 m) towering above.
